title: UBL activity diagram: the model
description: What one UBL UML activity diagram says: its lanes, nodes, flows and texts, and what refers to what. Where each element is drawn is in the diagram's layout file, keyed by these ids; how the extractor read it is in its extraction file. Written by tools/model_io.py.

name.description: the figure's basename, as in art/

source.description: the PNG it was read from, by file name

lanes.description: partitions: a column is a swimlane (a party), a band a horizontal division (a phase). Every diagram has at least one band, with an empty title where the artwork draws none.

index.description: position along its axis, left to right or top to bottom

titleShown.description: false where the artwork does not draw the title: it was given by a correction

titleSource.description: where a title the artwork does not draw comes from: stated by the specification's text, or implied by the convention of related figures

scope.description: the column is not a party of this process: it holds what starts or ends it from outside (q15)

kind.description: object is an object node (a document); fork is a fork or join bar

label.description: the words in the node, a newline where the artwork breaks the line

lane.description: the column lane it stands in; null for a document drawn on the line between two, and for a note that annotates something

between.description: a document (or a joint step, or a note) that belongs to no one column: for a document the parties that exchange it, left to right, as its flows say (two, or three where three take part); for a joint step or a note the two columns either side of the line it is drawn on. Where a document is drawn is the layout's.

annotates.description: for a note: the flow or segment it names - the information passing along an exchange no UBL document carries, or the part of the process it labels. The note belongs to no party; the flow's ends say who exchanges it

scope.description: the box stands for a whole process outside this diagram's scope, which it points at and does not describe (a BPMN call activity)

linkedProcess.description: for a start or an end: the other process it starts from or leads into, which the diagram names and does not describe

reference.description: for an external box: what process it stands for, and where the specification says so

sameAs.description: the same step drawn on another figure too (CPFR's Ordering on Figs 13 and 14)

unstated.description: attributes the artwork does not give, each with the reason (a decision with no question, a branch with no guard)

trigger.description: for a start: what sets it off where that is a time or an agreement rather than a message (in BPMN a timer or conditional start)

question.description: for a decision: the question written beside it, which says what is decided

definedIn.description: the package of the drawing tool's model the element was defined in, as UML-tool notation '(from <package>)' written under it says (Utility Billing)

kind.description: control flow, object flow (a document passing), a physical goods movement, a mutual precondition between two parties (not a step in sequence), or information exchanged between two parties that no UBL document carries (drawn with a note naming it, in place of a document box)

guard.description: the text that is this flow's guard; a lane id where the reading attached a lane title (see the extraction file's findings)

unstated.description: attributes the artwork does not give, each with the reason (a decision with no question, a branch with no guard)

bothEnds.description: an arrowhead at both ends: a standing relationship, not a flow from one to the other

checked.description: a person compared it with the artwork (tools/direction-verdicts.json)

texts.description: words on the page that are not a node's label or a lane's title: guards, and free labels

labels.description: the flow or off-page flow this text is attached to, or the node (a start or an end) it names, if any

offPage.description: a flow with only one end on this diagram

guard.description: the text that is this flow's guard

continues.description: the figure (by basename) this flow continues from, or into

port.description: the line's number where it crosses the frame, left to right; the same on both figures

counterpart.description: what this line is on the other figure: an off-page flow, or a flow where the step it meets is drawn on both

marks.description: a stroke across a partition rule (a BPMN-style break, on Figs 86/87)

rule.description: the axis of the rule it crosses

on.description: the flow the mark is drawn on

meaning.description: a BPMN break borrowed into the UML drawing: the flow goes to any of the 0..n parties of the lane it enters

phases.description: the dashed box a CPFR phase is drawn inside

title.description: the phase's name, written at the top of its box

members.description: the nodes that belong to the phase: those drawn inside its box

segments.description: a part of the process the diagram sets apart without drawing a box round it, such as an exchange the specification puts outside its scope; not drawn

members.description: the nodes and flows it holds; a flow's two ends are members too

scope.description: the part is outside the scope of the specification: the diagram shows it for context, and no UBL document passes in it

reference.description: what the part is, and where the specification says so
